title: Data Scientist
education: B.Tech / B.Sc / MCA or a relevant degree
typicalWork: Data analysis, building ML models, AI systems and business insights
description: Data Scientists turn raw data into decisions — building statistical models and machine-learning systems that power recommendations, forecasts and automated decisions across every industry.

title: Software Engineer
education: B.Tech / B.E in CSE, IT or related field
typicalWork: Designing, building and maintaining software products and platforms
description: Software Engineers design and build the applications, platforms and infrastructure that power modern products, from mobile apps to large-scale distributed systems.

title: Mechanical Engineer
typicalWork: Designing machines, engines, tools and manufacturing systems
description: Mechanical Engineers design, analyse and manufacture mechanical systems — from automotive components to industrial machinery and robotics.

title: Civil Engineer
typicalWork: Planning and overseeing construction of buildings, roads and infrastructure
description: Civil Engineers plan, design and supervise the construction of infrastructure that shapes cities — buildings, bridges, roads, dams and water systems.

title: Electrical Engineer
typicalWork: Designing, testing and maintaining electrical systems, power grids and machines
description: Electrical Engineers design and maintain the systems that generate, transmit and use electrical power — from home wiring and industrial motors to power grids, automation and renewable energy systems.

title: Electronics Engineer
education: B.Tech / B.E in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
typicalWork: Designing chips, circuits, communication systems and embedded devices
description: Electronics Engineers design the circuits, chips and communication systems inside phones, computers, vehicles and industrial equipment — from embedded firmware to semiconductor design.

title: Doctor (MBBS)
typicalWork: Diagnosing and treating patients, clinical practice, surgery or specialization
description: Doctors diagnose and treat illness and injury, working in hospitals, clinics or specialized practice after MBBS and further specialization through NEET-PG.

title: Nurse
typicalWork: Providing direct patient care in hospitals, clinics and community health settings
description: Nurses are the backbone of patient care — administering treatment, monitoring recovery and supporting patients and doctors across every healthcare setting.

title: Dentist
typicalWork: Diagnosing and treating dental and oral health conditions
description: Dentists diagnose and treat conditions of the teeth, gums and mouth, working in clinics, hospitals or their own private practice.

title: Pharmacist
typicalWork: Dispensing medication, advising patients, and working in pharma R&D or regulatory roles
description: Pharmacists ensure the safe and effective use of medication — dispensing prescriptions, advising patients, and working across retail, hospital and pharmaceutical R&D roles.

title: Research Scientist
education: M.Sc / Ph.D in a core science discipline
typicalWork: Conducting original research, publishing papers, and driving innovation in academia or industry R&D
description: Research Scientists push the boundaries of knowledge — designing experiments, analysing data and publishing findings across physics, chemistry, biology and applied sciences.

title: Data Analyst
education: B.Com / BBA / B.Tech with analytics skills
typicalWork: Analysing business data to support decisions, dashboards and reporting
description: Data Analysts turn business data into clear insights and dashboards that guide decision-making across marketing, operations and finance teams.

title: Chartered Accountant
education: B.Com + CA (Foundation, Intermediate, Final via ICAI)
typicalWork: Auditing, tax planning, financial advisory and corporate finance
description: Chartered Accountants manage financial reporting, taxation, auditing and compliance for businesses of every size, and are among India's most respected finance professionals.

title: Company Secretary
typicalWork: Ensuring statutory compliance, governance and board-level legal advisory for companies
description: Company Secretaries ensure corporate governance and statutory compliance — a respected, stable profession bridging law, finance and business administration.

title: Investment Banker
typicalWork: Advising companies on mergers, acquisitions, fundraising and capital markets
description: Investment Bankers help companies raise capital and execute mergers and acquisitions, working at the fast-paced, high-stakes intersection of finance and strategy.

title: Product Manager
education: Any degree + MBA or strong product experience
typicalWork: Defining product vision, prioritizing features and leading cross-functional teams
description: Product Managers sit at the intersection of business, design and engineering — deciding what gets built and why, and guiding it from idea to launch.

title: Business Analyst
education: Any degree, often with an MBA or analytics certification
typicalWork: Bridging business needs and technical solutions across projects
description: Business Analysts translate business problems into clear requirements and solutions, working closely with stakeholders, product and engineering teams.

title: HR Manager
education: Any degree + MBA (HR) or PG Diploma in HR
typicalWork: Leading recruitment, employee engagement and people policy for an organization
description: HR Managers build and lead the people function of an organization — hiring, developing and retaining talent, and shaping culture and workplace policy.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
education: Any degree + digital marketing certification or MBA
typicalWork: Planning and running digital campaigns across search, social and content to drive growth
description: Digital Marketing Managers plan and execute campaigns across search, social and content channels to grow brands and drive customer acquisition online.

title: Historian
typicalWork: Researching and interpreting historical records, teaching or working with museums and archives
description: Historians research, interpret and preserve the past — working in academia, museums, archives and public policy to make history accessible and understood.

title: Psychologist
typicalWork: Assessing and supporting mental health through therapy, counselling or research
description: Psychologists study the mind and behaviour, supporting mental health through therapy and counselling, or advancing the field through research.

title: Lawyer
typicalWork: Representing clients, drafting contracts and providing legal counsel
description: Lawyers advise clients, represent them in court and draft the agreements that structure business and personal life, across litigation and corporate practice.

title: Judge (Judicial Services)
typicalWork: Presiding over court proceedings and delivering judgments
description: Judges preside over legal proceedings and deliver judgments, entering the judiciary through competitive state judicial service examinations after an LLB.

title: UX Designer
typicalWork: Designing intuitive digital products through research, prototyping and testing
description: UX Designers shape how digital products look, feel and work — researching user needs and crafting intuitive, delightful interfaces from wireframe to pixel-perfect UI.

title: Graphic Designer
education: B.Des / Diploma in Graphic Design + portfolio
typicalWork: Creating visual content for branding, marketing and digital media
description: Graphic Designers communicate ideas visually — crafting logos, layouts, and marketing creative that shape how brands are seen and understood.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
typicalWork: Protecting systems and data from cyber threats and breaches
description: Cybersecurity Analysts defend systems, networks and data against attacks — monitoring threats, responding to incidents and hardening infrastructure.

title: Cloud Architect
typicalWork: Designing and managing scalable cloud infrastructure for organizations
description: Cloud Architects design the infrastructure that modern applications run on — balancing scalability, cost, and security across AWS, Azure and GCP.

title: IAS Officer
education: Any bachelor's degree + UPSC Civil Services Examination
typicalWork: Administering government policy and public services at district, state or national level
description: IAS Officers administer public policy and government services — among the most prestigious and responsible careers in India, entered through the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

title: IPS Officer
education: Any bachelor's degree + UPSC Civil Services Examination
typicalWork: Leading police forces and maintaining law and order at district and state level
description: IPS Officers lead police administration and law enforcement, maintaining public order and safety across districts, states and national agencies.

title: ISRO Scientist/Engineer
education: B.Tech/B.E in CS, Electronics, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering + ISRO ICRB exam or GATE
typicalWork: Designing, building and testing satellites, launch vehicles and space systems at ISRO centres
description: ISRO Scientists and Engineers design, build and test India's satellites, launch vehicles and space missions — recruited through ISRO's own Centralised Recruitment Board exam (ICRB) or a GATE score, across streams like Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering.

title: RRB Junior Engineer
education: Diploma or B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics Engineering + RRB JE exam
typicalWork: Maintaining and executing engineering works across Indian Railways' civil, mechanical, electrical and signal departments
description: RRB Junior Engineers maintain and execute engineering works across Indian Railways' civil, mechanical, electrical and signalling departments — one of India's most sought-after stable government engineering roles, open to diploma and degree holders alike.

title: SEBI Grade A Officer (IT)
education: B.Tech/B.E or MCA in IT/CS + SEBI Grade A exam
typicalWork: Overseeing the technology systems, cybersecurity and data infrastructure that regulate India's securities markets
description: SEBI Grade A Officers in the IT stream manage the technology systems, cybersecurity and data infrastructure behind India's securities market regulator — a prestigious, well-paid government-sector career for IT and computer science graduates.

title: Army Officer
typicalWork: Leading troops and operations in the Indian Army
description: Army Officers lead soldiers and operations in defence of the nation, entering through the NDA (after 12th) or CDS (after graduation) followed by officer training.

title: Bank Probationary Officer
education: Any bachelor's degree + Bank PO exams (IBPS/SBI)
typicalWork: Managing banking operations, loans and customer relationships as a future branch manager
description: Bank Probationary Officers begin a path toward branch and regional leadership in public and private banks, entering through competitive exams like IBPS PO and SBI PO.

title: Bank IT Officer
education: B.Tech/B.E or MCA in IT/CS + IBPS SO (IT) exam
typicalWork: Managing core banking technology, systems security and IT infrastructure for public sector banks
description: Bank IT Officers manage the technology backbone of India's public sector banks — core banking systems, network security and digital infrastructure — recruited through the IBPS Specialist Officer (IT) exam.

title: School Teacher
education: B.Ed after a bachelor's degree + TET
typicalWork: Teaching and mentoring students in schools
description: School Teachers shape the next generation — delivering curriculum, mentoring students and building the foundational skills children carry for life.

title: School Principal
education: B.Ed + several years of teaching experience (M.Ed preferred)
typicalWork: Leading a school's academic direction, staff and day-to-day administration
description: School Principals lead a school's academic vision, staff and administration — typically a senior-career step after years of classroom teaching experience.

title: Professor
typicalWork: Teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students and conducting academic research
description: Professors teach and mentor at the university level while advancing their field through original research and academic publication.

title: Agricultural Scientist
typicalWork: Researching crop yields, soil health and sustainable farming practices
description: Agricultural Scientists research crop science, soil health and sustainable farming methods that improve yields and food security.

title: Hotel Manager
typicalWork: Managing hotel operations, staff and guest experience
description: Hotel Managers run every aspect of hospitality operations — from guest experience to staffing and budgets — across hotels and resorts.

title: Journalist
typicalWork: Reporting, researching and producing news and feature content
description: Journalists research, verify and tell the stories that inform the public — across print, broadcast and digital media.

title: Electrician
typicalWork: Installing and repairing electrical systems in homes, offices and industry
description: Electricians install, maintain and repair electrical systems — a hands-on, always-in-demand skilled trade entered through an ITI diploma.

title: Plumber
typicalWork: Installing and repairing water, gas and drainage systems
description: Plumbers install and maintain the water, gas and drainage systems every building depends on — a stable, hands-on trade entered through an ITI diploma.

title: Fitness Trainer
typicalWork: Designing training programs and coaching clients toward fitness goals
description: Fitness Trainers design workout and nutrition programs and coach clients toward health and performance goals, in gyms, studios or independently.

title: Entrepreneur
education: Any background — the venture is the credential
typicalWork: Building and running your own venture, from idea to scale
description: Entrepreneurs identify problems worth solving and build ventures around them — taking on risk and ownership in exchange for the chance to build something new.

title: AI/ML Engineer
education: B.Tech/M.Tech in CS/AI or strong self-taught portfolio
typicalWork: Building and deploying machine learning and AI systems at scale
description: AI/ML Engineers build the machine learning systems behind modern products — from recommendation engines to generative AI, one of the fastest-growing fields today.

title: Sustainability Consultant
typicalWork: Advising organizations on environmental, social and governance strategy
description: Sustainability Consultants help organizations reduce environmental impact and meet ESG goals — a fast-growing field as climate strategy becomes core business.
